_doc: Reply rules for the lead-monitor. For each NEW comment, the FIRST matching rule fires -> posts `reply` (NEVER put a link here) publicly + DMs `dm` (the link/resource goes HERE). Match by comment-text keyword (match_text), post id (match_media_id), or caption substring (match_caption). No match -> deferred for a human. Add one rule per reel that has a 'comment WORD -> I'll DM it' CTA.
dm_default: 🙌 thanks for reaching out! Tell me which reel's resource you want and I'll send it over.

rules.dm:
Here's the Claude + Figma stack 🙌

1) Connect Claude to Figma: run `claude plugin install figma@claude-plugins-official` — now Claude reads your designs.
2) Get the free content skills: /plugin marketplace add Ootto-AI/claude-content-skills (github.com/Ootto-AI/claude-content-skills).
3) Then Claude builds + posts your reels and DMs your leads on autopilot — the whole setup is here: github.com/Ootto-AI/claude-figma-stack

Lmk what you build!
